propositions: Plan review PASS verdict does not persist a signed attestation by default on all public routes, leaving reviewable tickets unsigned despite incurred LLM cost and blocking subsequent claim-gate validation.
The CLI plan-review entry point and library review_plan function lack enforced, tested defaults that guarantee sign-on-PASS behavior across all mutating public boundaries.
Deliberately skipping attestation signature requires explicit opt-out (CLI --no-sign, library sign=False) with clear output indicating unsigned status and reason.

BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and local/unattested-source plan-review results must remain unsigned; explicit sign=False must also withhold signatures, and these guards must be pinned at the attest.sign_plan_review artifact.
Re-invoking plan review with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it without re-running the LLM or emitting duplicate signatures.
A PASS with failed signature persistence must return a retryable nonzero disposition, identify sign-review as the recovery path, and preserve idempotent reuse of the current attestation.
